events.title: Utah Jazz vs. Denver Nuggets
events.addr: 301 W South Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
events.blurb: The Jazz host division rival Denver on Black Friday night in an NBA Cup game downtown.
events.blurbEs: Los Jazz reciben a su rival de división Denver la noche del Black Friday en un partido de la NBA Cup en el centro.

events.title: Utah Jazz vs. Phoenix Suns
events.addr: 301 W South Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
events.blurb: A Sunday afternoon tip-off against Phoenix, an easy game for families to fit into the holiday weekend.
events.blurbEs: Un partido el domingo por la tarde contra Phoenix, fácil de encajar en el fin de semana festivo con la familia.

events.title: Utah Utes vs. West Virginia
events.addr: 451 S 1400 E, Salt Lake City, UT 84112
events.blurb: University of Utah football closes the regular season at home under the lights on Friday night. Dress for a cold evening in the stands.
events.blurbEs: El fútbol americano de la Universidad de Utah cierra la temporada regular en casa el viernes por la noche. Vístete para una noche fría en las gradas.

events.title: Messiah Sing-In with Utah Symphony
events.addr: 123 W South Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
events.blurb: Utah Symphony performs Handel's Messiah and the audience is invited to sing along with the choruses.
events.blurbEs: La Utah Symphony interpreta el Mesías de Händel y el público está invitado a cantar los coros.

events.title: Bryan Callen
events.addr: 190 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
events.blurb: Comedian and podcaster Bryan Callen plays two shows a night Friday and Saturday at Wiseguys in The Gateway.
events.blurbEs: El comediante y podcaster Bryan Callen ofrece dos funciones por noche el viernes y el sábado en Wiseguys, en The Gateway.

events.title: Christmas Lights at Temple Square
events.addr: 50 W North Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84150
events.blurb: The downtown holiday lights switch on for the season on Friday and stay lit nightly through Jan. 1, with a projection show on the Tabernacle dome.
events.blurbEs: Las luces navideñas del centro se encienden el viernes para la temporada y siguen cada noche hasta el 1 de enero, con una proyección sobre la cúpula del Tabernáculo.

events.title: Hogle Holidays: A ZooLights Experience
events.addr: 2600 Sunnyside Ave S, Salt Lake City, UT 84108
events.blurb: The zoo stays open after dark with light displays along the paths. A good outing for kids, about 15 minutes east of downtown.
events.blurbEs: El zoológico abre de noche con luces a lo largo de los senderos. Un buen plan con niños, a unos 15 minutos al este del centro.

events.title: Wheeler Farm Annual Holiday Market
events.blurb: More than 50 local vendors and food trucks at the historic farm in Murray, a free alternative to Black Friday at the mall.
events.blurbEs: Más de 50 vendedores locales y food trucks en la granja histórica de Murray, una alternativa gratuita al Black Friday en el centro comercial.
